notes.models: Planning, bounded research and review use the strongest configured model. Implementation and one-pass fixes use the cheaper configured model.
notes.campaign: Harness v2 runs at most seven campaign cycles. Infrastructure pauses do not advance a cycle; resume continues the saved stage.
notes.holdout: --holdout is adaptive hidden validation and stays outside the repository. --final-holdout is optional, sealed, distinct, and used only after the campaign reaches its goal.
notes.research: Research is a separate bounded action with at most two strong-model calls per campaign and at most three reported external sources per call.
notes.review: Reviewer and Fixer are conditional. Public and hidden metric gates run first so obviously bad candidates do not spend strong-model review budget.
notes.indexing: Agents may request a rebuild but must not run a full rebuild themselves. The supervisor owns the global budget of five rebuilds.
